name: identity_start_otp
description: Start identity verification before revealing or changing any personal information. Matches the caller's ID number and date of birth and sends a 6 digit code to the phone on file: by SMS, or by a voice call that reads it twice when channel is voice or the caller noted codes by voice call. Returns verification_id and the last 3 digits of that phone. If it returns no_match, ask the caller to check both details, without saying which one was wrong.

id_number.description: The ID number exactly as the caller confirmed it

date_of_birth.description: The caller's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

channel.description: voice if the caller cannot read texts or asked for the code by phone call; otherwise leave out
